title: Acceso público y difusión digital: 'poner a disposición de' y 'celebrarse periódicamente'

sections.content: To describe digital public resources and periodic cultural summits, Spanish uses 'poner a disposición de + destinatario' (to make available to) and 'celebrarse cada tres años / periódicamente'. Since 1997, the Instituto Cervantes has operated the **Centro Virtual Cervantes (CVC)**, which makes teaching resources, literature, and the **CCSE portal** freely available to students and teachers worldwide. Every year, the Instituto Cervantes also publishes the official yearbook ***El español en el mundo*** (demographic and cultural report on the Spanish language) and co-organizes with the RAE and ASALE the **Congresos Internacionales de la Lengua Española (CILE)**.

items.spanish: El Centro Virtual Cervantes pone recursos educativos y culturales a disposición de estudiantes y profesores.
items.english: The Centro Virtual Cervantes makes educational and cultural resources available to students and teachers.

items.spanish: El Instituto Cervantes publica anualmente el informe demográfico «El español en el mundo».
items.english: The Instituto Cervantes annually publishes the demographic report 'Spanish in the World'.

items.spanish: Los Congresos Internacionales de la Lengua Española reúnen a escritores, académicos y expertos de todo el ámbito hispánico.
items.english: The International Congresses of the Spanish Language bring together writers, academics, and experts from across the Hispanic world.

sections.content: Remember: the official portal where candidates register for the **CCSE** and **DELE** exams and download the free annual preparation manual is managed by the **Instituto Cervantes** (`examenes.cervantes.es`).
